h: Health Minister says Nigeria could declare itself Ebola-free from 7 December
p: Health Minister Ali Pate has said Nigeria can declare its Ebola outbreak over as early as 7 December 2026, provided no new cases are recorded. Contacts of the earlier patient remain under monitoring.
more: The countdown depends on the end of the monitoring period for contacts.
The NCDC has urged Nigerians to rely on official updates.
